import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

df = pd.read_csv('/data/worldbank_education_gdp.csv')

# Identify the rows with the relevant series names
labor_force_row = df[df['Series Name'] == 'Labor force participation rate, total (percentage of total population ages 15+) (modeled ILO estimate)']
primary_enrollment_row = df[df['Series Name'] == 'School enrollment, primary (percentage gross)']
secondary_enrollment_row = df[df['Series Name'] == 'School enrollment, secondary (percentage gross)']
export_growth_row = df[df['Series Name'] == 'Exports of goods and services (annual percentage growth)']

# Reshape the data to have one row per country group and year
labor_force_data = labor_force_row.set_index('Country Code').drop(columns=['Country Group', 'Series Name', 'Series Code']).T.reset_index()
labor_force_data.columns = ['Year', 'SSF_Labor', 'LMC_Labor']

primary_enrollment_data = primary_enrollment_row.set_index('Country Code').drop(columns=['Country Group', 'Series Name', 'Series Code']).T.reset_index()
primary_enrollment_data.columns = ['Year', 'SSF_Primary', 'LMC_Primary']

secondary_enrollment_data = secondary_enrollment_row.set_index('Country Code').drop(columns=['Country Group', 'Series Name', 'Series Code']).T.reset_index()
secondary_enrollment_data.columns = ['Year', 'SSF_Secondary', 'LMC_Secondary']

export_growth_data = export_growth_row.set_index('Country Code').drop(columns=['Country Group', 'Series Name', 'Series Code']).T.reset_index()
export_growth_data.columns = ['Year', 'SSF_Export', 'LMC_Export']

# Merge the data into a single DataFrame
df_merged = pd.merge(labor_force_data, primary_enrollment_data, on='Year', suffixes=('', '_primary'))
df_merged = pd.merge(df_merged, secondary_enrollment_data, on='Year', suffixes=('', '_secondary'))
df_merged = pd.merge(df_merged, export_growth_data, on='Year', suffixes=('', '_export'))

# Drop rows with missing values
df_merged = df_merged.dropna()

# Prepare the data for regression
X = df_merged[['SSF_Labor', 'LMC_Labor', 'SSF_Primary', 'LMC_Primary', 'SSF_Secondary', 'LMC_Secondary']]
y = df_merged['SSF_Export']

# Create a linear regression model
model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(X, y)

# Get the coefficients
coefficients = model.coef_
coefficients
